name: Hidden Threat (Combat)
body:
You gain greater benefit from being unnoticed before you strike.

Prerequisite(s): Stealth 5 ranks

Benefit(s): You gain an additional +2 bonus on attack rolls against targets unaware of your presence and reduce the penalty for sniping while staying hidden to -10. If your attack is a critical hit, this penalty is -5.
